tmp:1128: zokheh ledaber bekhol pa'am dibburim chadashim — the merited state of speaking ever-new words in hitbodedut prayer before God, a personal ruach ha-kodesh modeled on David composing Psalms
tmp:1129: lefi ha-zivvug she-gorem bitfilato — the measure/quality of the supernal union (zivvug of the Holy One and the Shekhinah) that a person causes through his prayer, the determining cause of his own match
tmp:1130: zokheh le-zivvugo — meriting one's earthly marriage partner (one's match), granted in correspondence to the supernal union effected by one's prayer
tmp:1131: zokheh limtzo ha-petach — the attainment of finding the opening/doorway (to holiness/light) achieved through truth, since God the illuminating light is present only where there is no falsehood
tmp:1132: he'arot ha-avot — the illuminations of the three Patriarchs (Avraham, Yitzchak, Yaakov), whose light enables Shabbat, ceasing of the enemy, and peace, rebuilding the gate of holiness
tmp:1133: ha-tze'akah — the cry/scream (in prayer) that births the mochin (intellects) out of their concealment, the first prerequisite for attaining holy da'at
tmp:1135: tze'akah be-Torah u-tefillah — crying out in Torah study and prayer, the means for drawing concealed surrounding lights (makkifin) toward revelation
tmp:1139: zokhin li-teshuvah ve-nishlam ha-da'at — the state attained via Torah of repentance completed and da'at (mind) restored/settled, whereby scattered letters and combinations return to their place and mercy can be aroused
tmp:1140: she-amad ba-nisayon ve-shibber ha-klipah she-kadmah la-pri — one who withstood the sexual trial and broke the husk (klipah) that precedes the fruit, i.e., shattering the lust of ni'uf, the tikkun ha-klali of all seventy evil traits
tmp:1144: Ze'ir Anpin (zeira de-anpin) — the kabbalistic partzuf 'Small Face,' here denoting all wisdoms attainable by the human mind, revealed-yet-not-revealed, as opposed to hidden Atik
tmp:1145: avuha de-abba — 'the father's father' (grandfather) in the Talmudic carob story, symbolizing the aspect of zaken/Atik, the ancient primordial level
tmp:1146: charuv — the carob tree of Choni's story, symbolizing zaken/Atik (the Ancient One), linked via berosh-cypress to Mordekhai and rav chesed by gematria
tmp:1148: chut ha-shani — the scarlet thread (of Zerach, Genesis 38), symbolizing the shining of the light of the Divine countenance (or ha-panim) upon one, opposite the darkness of livelihood-worry
tmp:1150: zera tamei — impure/contaminated seed, the defiled 'bitter waters' state of one who blemished his brit (covenant), rendering him unable to pray with all his bones
tmp:1154: ahavah — love as the tzaddik's loving acceptance of insult/disgrace (from the scholar's arrogant words), constituting the aspect of 'embrace' (chibbuk)
tmp:1157: chiddush ha-neshamah — the renewal of the soul, identified with the light of the countenance and renewal of the mochin, equated with building the Beit HaMikdash ('one with da'at is as if the Temple were built in his days')
tmp:1158: chiddush ha-sekhel, haynu chiddush ha-neshamah — renewal of the intellect, i.e., of the soul, effected through sleep ('new every morning'), when weary mochin are refreshed
tmp:1159: nesher she-bivchinat nefesh — the eagle within the soul-level (nefesh): the renewal the soul undergoes in its ascent in ibur (gestation), per 'your youth is renewed like the eagle'
tmp:1160: chiddush she-nitchadesh ha-nefesh ba-aliyatah bivchinat ibur — the soul's renewal achieved in its ascent through the state of gestation (ibur), the 'eagle' renewal of Psalm 103:5
tmp:1161: nesher she-ba-Torah — the eagle among the four chayot within Torah: chiddushin d'Orayta, novel Torah insights, per 'renewed like the eagle'
tmp:1162: hitorerut chadash ve-cheshek nimratz la-Torah — a fresh awakening and intense yearning for Torah granted to lesser souls unable to innovate, itself a form of chiddush (renewal)
tmp:1163: chiddushin — novelty/renewals: here the category of Torah-newness that includes even renewed desire and awakening for Torah in those who cannot themselves innovate
tmp:1165: chedvat Hashem — 'the joy of God is your stronghold' (Nehemiah 8:10): divine joy/gladness that is the source of holy boldness (azut dikdushah), attained via na'aseh ve-nishma
tmp:1167: chozer ve-nitgaleh chokhmato — the wisdom that departed (the elder who forgot his learning) returning and being revealed again, via the cold reviving waters of da'at from the true tzaddik
tmp:1168: lefi ha-teshuvah, lefi ha-machaloket — the correspondence whereby answers/books (responsa) arise in measure with the dispute/questions raised, each machaloket generating a needed sefer
tmp:1169: chozer ve-shav el emunat chakhamim — returning in repentance to faith in the Sages, whereby books once mocked ('making many books') regain their necessity and worth
tmp:1170: she-osin retzono yitbarakh — Israel's fulfilling of God's will, the purpose of creation, whereby they return and cleave to their root and are re-included in Him, the Necessary Existent
tmp:1171: chozrin nitzotzei chelkei ha-mizbeach limkomam ve-nishlam ha-mizbeach — the return of the scattered holy sparks of the altar's parts to their place via converts (gerim), completing/repairing the blemished altar that empowered idolatry
tmp:1172: keshe-lomed ba-laylah — studying Torah at night, which draws a thread of chesed (loving-kindness) that protects one even when learning she-lo lishmah (for the title 'Rabbi')
tmp:1173: bechinat yadayim ha-nal — the aforementioned aspect of the two hands (the strong hand and the hand that magnifies/strengthens), by which the 'hardness of birthing' is removed when new honor arrives
tmp:1174: cholefet ve-overet ha-kishui leyled — the passing away of the birthing-hardness (difficulty of labor, kishui leiled) effected through the 'hands,' per 'my bow is renewed in my hand'
tmp:1175: cholkim alav — the opposition/dispute against one: people contesting and interrogating him ('who is he?'), the fate of one who pursues honor of kings rather than honor of God
tmp:1178: chotam — the seal: the tzaddik as the 'seal' of the holy covenant ('his offspring He sealed with the sign of the brit'), i.e., the guardian of the brit (shomer ha-brit)
tmp:1180: ma'asim tovim — good deeds, the primary source of the heart's strength to contain intellect; when wisdom exceeds deeds the heart cannot hold the returning thought
tmp:1181: chizzuk ha-lev — the strengthening/fortification of the heart, achieved chiefly through good deeds, enabling the heart to contain intellectual thought
tmp:1182: chazanim hem belo da'at — the folk-saying that cantors are fools lacking da'at, explained by the exile of Malkhut of holiness which blemishes melody drawn from the prophets' place
tmp:1184: yirat shamayim — fear of Heaven as the sanctification of the nose (chotem), per 'he shall smell with the fear of God' (Isaiah 11:3), one of the four sanctified facial organs
tmp:1191: machashavot kedoshot — holy thoughts, which are the aspect of pure (kosher) animals set to battle impure ones in the parable of kings watching animal combat
tmp:1192: chayot tehorot — pure/kosher animals as the symbol for holy thoughts in the royal animal-combat parable, opposed to impure animals (evil thoughts)
tmp:1194: chayot temeiot — impure/non-kosher animals as the symbol for evil thoughts, set against pure animals (holy thoughts) in the kings' combat parable
